questions.question: You’re late for a meeting with colleagues, and your boss says, *'Sorry I’m running a bit late today—my car broke down on the way here.'* How would you best respond if you wanted to offer support?
options: That’s fine, I’m used to being late.
Oh no, I’m so sorry about that! Let me get you a coffee while you wait.
You’re not late at all—it’s not a problem.
I’ll make sure you’re not kept waiting long.
questions.answer: Oh no, I’m so sorry about that! Let me get you a coffee while you wait.

questions.question: A friend asks, *'Do you think we should move to that new café downtown? It’s so trendy and has great reviews.'* How would you respond if you strongly disagree and prefer a local option?
options: Yes, it’s definitely worth trying out—it’s amazing!
I’m not sure, but I’ve heard it’s expensive.
I don’t think it’s worth the hype; I’d rather go to the one near my house.
That sounds nice, but I’m too busy today.
questions.answer: I don’t think it’s worth the hype; I’d rather go to the one near my house.

questions.question: Your partner says, *'I’ve been really stressed with work lately. Can we go for a walk after dinner?'* How would you best respond to express agreement and offer to help?
options: That sounds great! I’ll book a table for us.
I’m sorry to hear that—let’s definitely do something relaxing.
I don’t think a walk will help much with stress.
I’ll cancel our plans and stay in instead.
questions.answer: That sounds great! I’ll book a table for us.

questions.question: At a formal dinner, a guest says, *'I’m afraid I’ve made a small mistake—my name tag was swapped with someone else’s.'* How would you best respond to apologise and offer reassurance?
options: That’s not a problem at all—I’m sure you’ll find it fine.
I’m sorry to hear that—let’s fix it immediately.
I didn’t notice; it’s no issue.
I’ll ask someone to check for you.
questions.answer: That’s not a problem at all—I’m sure you’ll find it fine.

questions.question: A colleague asks, *'Would you mind if I borrow your pen for just a minute?'* How would you best respond if you’re willing to share but want to be polite?
options: No, go ahead—I’ve got plenty more.
Of course not, but you’d better hurry—it’s not mine!
I don’t have another one, so I’d better not.
I’m sorry, I don’t have any extra pens here.
questions.answer: No, go ahead—I’ve got plenty more.
